title: Carbide Create Job Runtime Leaderboard
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=carbide:job runtime_min=*
| stats sum(runtime_min) as total_value, avg(runtime_min) as avg_value by tool_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks tool values by total and average runtime across Carbide Create job events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `runtime_min` values for each Carbide Create job event and review total and average runtime by tool.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total runtime.
grandmaExplanation: It steadily which tool shows the biggest runtime numbers in your Carbide Create job data.
